mandatoryAnswer: Based on the verified repository and exact release evidence, Qelly is approximately 78-84% complete overall. Prompt 2B remains complete within its authorized scope. Prompt 2C implementation is approximately 84-90% complete, but activation is only 0-5% because no globally reachable exact-head deployment, live Supabase project, real RLS isolation, cloud synchronization or LinkedIn publication has been verified. The largest truthful increase is one normal GitHub dashboard action: authorize release/qelly-global-public-beta in the github-pages environment. After public qelly-release.json equals 603cece3091dc59cfb72680914e7056b40058022, the dependency order is Supabase Free migrations and auth, two-user RLS isolation, cloud sync/account rights, deployed provider and nonfunctional gates, rollback, then official LinkedIn publication.
